title: Understand Conditional Probability
text: We need P(2nd ball is blue | 1st ball was red).\n\nThis is asking: GIVEN that we already drew a red ball, what is the probability the next ball is blue?

title: Determine Remaining Balls
text:
After removing one red ball:
- Red balls remaining = 4
- Blue balls remaining = 3 (unchanged)
- Total remaining = 7

title: Calculate the Probability
text: P(2nd blue | 1st red) = $\frac{\text{Blue balls remaining}}{\text{Total remaining}} = \frac{3}{7}$\n\nThis is approximately 0.429 or about 43%.
